wish: someone should make an app that helps with speed reading
spec:
Shows pasted text one word at a time at a fixed point, with the focus letter marked, at a chosen words-per-minute.
Paste text, press play; pause, jump back 10 words, scrub, or change speed with +/- (space, left, up/down on a keyboard).
It does not fetch articles or files from the web; pausing longer on punctuation is its only pacing trick.

type.text: speed reading means seeing words without moving your eyes
